technology_name: Powder Jaggery Processing from Sugarcane Juice with Organic Clarificants
institution: ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute Research Centre, Kannur
problem_solved: Need for stable and high-quality powdered jaggery products
description: This technology produces powder jaggery by reducing the water content of sugarcane juice and using organic clarificants during processing. The resulting product is characterized by improved uniformity, colour, taste, clarity, and storage stability. The process provides an alternative method for preparing powdered jaggery suitable for food applications.
applications:
Jaggery production and sugarcane processing industries
Natural sweetener and food ingredient manufacturers
Bakery, confectionery, and processed food companies
Health food, organic food, and nutraceutical enterprises
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agro-processing startups
secondary_sector: Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
